name: The Hand of the Righteous
label: Quest
description: The Hand of the Righteous: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Choose your deputies wisely, mortal. Each time you return with your task complete, a new deputy you will be allowed to choose.
With that said, I require more of the carapace fragments. Waste no time!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Perhaps one day the whole of Cenarion Hold will be working under your command.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, hero. You will now be granted the ability to deputize another Agent of Nozdormu.
